items.title: Ida Goodson Interview, 1961-05-06
items.q: Joseph LaCroix Pierce. Mm-hmm. And they're better known as Didi.

ctx.x: Willie Madison Goodson. Pierce. All right. And what's your name, Didi?
Joseph LaCroix Pierce. Mm-hmm. And they're better known as Didi. But and your what?
Rose Thomas. How do you spell it? R-O-Y-C-E. T-H-O-M-A-N.
